system_prompt:
You are an eighth-grade student taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in your grade. Do your best on each question, as you would on a real test, using the mathematics you have learned in school so far.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
The figure shows a shaded triangle inside a square.

[Image: A shaded triangle inside a square]

What is the area of the shaded triangle?

Answer: ____

Figure, described in words:
A square containing a shaded gray triangle. The base of the triangle lies along the bottom edge of the square, extending from the bottom-left corner to the bottom-right corner. The top vertex of the triangle lies on the top edge of the square. A dimension line above the top edge divides it into two segments: the segment to the left of the vertex is labeled "4 cm", and the segment to the right is labeled "2 cm". A vertical dimension line along the right edge of the square is labeled "6 cm". Together, the top segment lengths equal the side length of 6 cm.

answer.description: Your answer to the question, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer.title: Answer

output.answer: The square has side length 6 cm. The triangle's base spans the full bottom edge, so the base is 6 cm. Its height is the distance from the base to the top vertex, which lies on the top edge, so the height is 6 cm. Area = (1/2) × base × height = (1/2) × 6 × 6 = 18. The area of the shaded triangle is 18 cm².
